acceptance_predicates.description: Every public command family completes contract-driven human/help/list/selection journeys.
TTY, redirected, JSON, and quiet modes retain their specified contracts.
A clean project can discover choices and reach documented selection commands without raw JSON interpretation.

outputs.description: Exact-head end-to-end evidence for complete public CLI usability.

gates.description: All command families and output modes pass the generated UX matrix.
